cards.card_text: Israel joins in worshiping a false god, Baal of Peor.
cards.verse_text: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.
cards.snippet: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.

cards.card_text: Next, Moses gives an order to the ___ of Israel: each of them must kill all of his men who joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.
cards.verse_text: So Moses told the judges of Israel, “Each of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.”
cards.snippet: …of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.”

cards.card_text: Soon all Israel prostitutes themselves by worshiping Gideon's ephod in Ophrah, his hometown.
cards.verse_text: But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.
cards.snippet: But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.

cards.card_text: And others will answer them: it's because Israel forsook the LORD their God and embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them.
cards.verse_text: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.’”
cards.snippet: …fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster…

cards.card_text: Then one day, while he's worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to the sword and escape to the land of Ararat.

cards.verse_text: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”

cards.card_text: The rest of mankind lives through these plagues, and they keep worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood.
cards.verse_text: They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
